data.name: Enemy Ground
data.description: The witch curses a target with clumsiness when in dangerous terrain. The target takes a -%1 penalty on Acrobatics checks to move over slippery or uneven surfaces and to avoid attacks of opportunity while moving through threatened squares. This effect lasts for 1 minute. On a successful Will save, the penalty is reduced by half and the duration is only 1 round.|WitchEnemyGround
